Name: Intranet Portal
Description: The staff intranet behind a proxy provider
Purpose: A proxy provider, the shape every reverse-proxy integration takes

Name: Expense Portal
Purpose: A confidential client with a strict redirect URI

Name: Engineering Wiki
Description: The engineering wiki, public client with a regex redirect
Purpose: A public client and a regex redirect, which most integrations get wrong

Name: Payroll Console
Description: Payroll, restricted to finance by policy
Purpose: The policy target that admits one department and denies contractors

Name: Legacy Reporting Tool
Description: A registered application with no provider and no launch URL
Purpose: An application that exists but cannot be launched; a report must show it as such

Name: Hidden Utility
Purpose: meta_hide set, so it is absent from what a user sees and present in what an admin lists

Name: Partner Portal
Description: A SAML service provider, responses signed by the seeded keypair
Purpose: The enterprise integration most demos are about; a signed response needs a certificate, which the seed generates

Name: Directory Gateway
Description: An LDAP provider for the appliances that speak nothing else
Purpose: Served only through an outpost and hidden from the library; the object exists for what an inventory has to show

Name: Network Access
Description: A RADIUS provider for the switches and the VPN concentrator
Purpose: The shared secret is generated at creation and never written to the CSV; MFA support is on, which changes how a client must send the code
